name: LMCache GitHub repository
notes: Repository created 2024-05-28, pushed_at 2026-10-03 — i.e. actively maintained, not abandoned. Description: 'LMCache: Supercharge Your LLM with the Fastest KV Cache Layer'. vLLM ships LMCacheConnectorV1 and LMCacheMPConnector integration points for disaggregated prefilling, so LMCache is wired into vLLM as an external KV cache layer rather than being a vLLM subsystem.
